question.problem: What is the value of $f(t)=[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡2t \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t+\frac{\pi }{2}) \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡t\end{aligned}]$ at $t=\frac{\pi }{4}?$
question.worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=\frac{\pi }{4}$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(\frac{\pi }{4}) & =[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{4}) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{4}+\frac{\pi }{2}) \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡\pi  \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So the value of $f(t)$ at $t=\frac{\pi }{4}$ is the vector $[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$
